item_merges.reason: The cote23 page explicitly specializes its complete linearly topological algebra to the discrete topology, where topological nilpotence becomes ordinary nilpotence (Pro1431–1446). Cote68 Th1 is this very finite algebraic specialization (Pro77–95), not merely a neighboring use of exp. Preserve: The false literal cote23 display log(gg′)=log(g)log(g′) and its dual-number refutation.; The separate cote68 marginal exp1=0 reading alarm.; Cote68’s live réciproque? question and its exact universal-identity interpretation.; Closedness/topology hypotheses in cote23 versus finite polynomial hypotheses in cote68.

overrides.statement: Over a Q-algebra, exp and log are reciprocal on the stated nilpotent domains; commuting arguments carry addition to multiplication and conversely. The broader topological, formal-parameter or degreewise variants remain separately specified in source_records and the claim map.

item_merges.reason: Cote23 writes exactly this equivalence for a k-bilinear product (Pro1692–1700). Cote68 explicitly allows nonassociative/nonunital/noncommutative products and concludes that for nilpotent u the same criterion is equivalent to exp(u) being an algebra automorphism (Pro376–380). The hypotheses and object agree. Preserve: Uniform nilpotence in the single exp(D) criterion.; The formal-parameter action statement for an arbitrary infinitesimal endomorphism.; Degreewise versus uniform nilpotence on an unbounded tensor algebra.; The square-zero/BCH specialization in cote23 and the fact that its supplied verification belongs to the earlier run.

overrides.statement: For a uniformly nilpotent endomorphism D of a module with a bilinear multiplication over a Q-algebra, D is a derivation if and only if exp(D) preserves the multiplication; associativity, a unit and commutativity are not required. The broader topological, formal-parameter or degreewise variants remain separately specified in source_records and the claim map.

item_merges.reason: Both sources write the same endomorphism ideal and identity-mod-J group. Cote23 inserts the common exponent and calls the whole ideal nilpotent (Pro1704–1731).
